name: Exage 400LX
generation: Documented in Shimano’s 1990 manufacturer dealer manual, earlier than the 1991/1992 references previously reviewed. The start year records the first reviewed dated availability reference, not a claimed launch year.

sources.title: Shimano 1992 dealer product manual, PDF page 34 / printed 31: Exage 400LX exact inventory: RD-M400-SGS 330 g, separate GS/SS limits, FD-M400-B/FD-M400, FC-M400-SG 170 mm 48/38/28T 763 g, BR-M201 and rear-only BR-M352

Shimano 1991 dealer product manual, PDF page 72 / printed 69: Exage 400LX named range: ST-M050 explicitly 305 g four-finger pair, SL-M453 184 g per pair, BL-M350-B 294 g per pair, FC-M400 170 mm 48/38/28T 763 g and BR-M351

Shimano 1990 dealer product manual, PDF page 56 / printed 53: Exage 400LX: RD-M400-GS explicitly 318 g; FD-M400 132 g normal band with sole 28.0–28.6 mm band; BB-M500 and shared 500LX cassette inventory
